item.name: native-intf-security
item.description:
Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Interface — Security & Access Control

Interface security: 802.1X, MAB, MACsec, trust boundaries, access sessions.

**Representative type:** GigabitEthernet (paths work identically for TenGigabitEthernet, HundredGigE, Loopback, Vlan, Tunnel, etc. — just substitute the type name in the URL).

**All 57 interface types:** ATM, ATM-ACR, AppGigabitEthernet, AppNav-Compress, AppNav-UnCompress, Async, BD-VIF, BDI, Bundle, CEM, CEM-ACR, Cellular, Dialer, Embedded-Service-Engine, Ethernet, Ethernet-Internal, FastEthernet, FiftyGigabitEthernet

Endpoints: 31 | Operations: 124

item.name: native-intf-services
item.description:
Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Interface — Network Services

Per-interface services: ARP, logging, domain, MOP, backup, redundancy.

**Representative type:** GigabitEthernet (paths work identically for TenGigabitEthernet, HundredGigE, Loopback, Vlan, Tunnel, etc. — just substitute the type name in the URL).

**All 57 interface types:** ATM, ATM-ACR, AppGigabitEthernet, AppNav-Compress, AppNav-UnCompress, Async, BD-VIF, BDI, Bundle, CEM, CEM-ACR, Cellular, Dialer, Embedded-Service-Engine, Ethernet, Ethernet-Internal, FastEthernet, FiftyGigabitEthernet, Fiv

Endpoints: 101 | Operations: 404

item.name: native-intf-switching
item.description:
Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Interface — Switchport & L2

Layer 2 switchport mode, VLAN assignment, trunk config, storm control, and L2 protocol tunneling.

**Representative type:** GigabitEthernet (paths work identically for TenGigabitEthernet, HundredGigE, Loopback, Vlan, Tunnel, etc. — just substitute the type name in the URL).

**All 57 interface types:** ATM, ATM-ACR, AppGigabitEthernet, AppNav-Compress, AppNav-UnCompress, Async, BD-VIF, BDI, Bundle, CEM, CEM-ACR, Cellular, Dialer, Embedded-Service-Engine, Ethernet, Ethernet-Internal, FastEthernet

Endpoints: 116 | Operations: 464

item.name: native-intf-types
item.description:
Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Interface Types Overview

All 57 interface types in the Cisco-IOS-XE-native model.

Each type is a YANG list keyed by `name`. Features are nearly identical across types — see the feature-specific specs (IP Addressing, Switchport, QoS, etc.) for deep paths using GigabitEthernet as representative.

**Type categories:**
- **Physical Ethernet:** GigabitEthernet, TenGigabitEthernet, TwentyFiveGigE, FortyGigabitEthernet, FiftyGigabitEthernet, HundredGigE, TwoHundredGigE, FourHundredGigE, FiveGigabitEthernet, TwoGigabitEthernet

Endpoints: 57 | Operations: 228
